title: Monotone Influence Selection Program
statement: For a dimension $n\in\mathbb{N}$, a positive rational influence bound $t$, and a rational learning parameter $0<\varepsilon\leq 1/2$, define a random-example learning program that draws a matrix of independent uniform labeled examples, with one sample batch for each member of the singleton Fourier family. The batch size is the singleton influence sample count, the charged local work is the family size times the batch size times $n+1$, plus $n$, and the output is the set of empirically influential coordinates.
caveat: The singleton Fourier family, singleton influence sample count, and empirical influential-coordinate rule are referenced but not defined in the payload.
